note: Boarding hall of the Funitel valley station at Priehyba as in the 2015 photo (and the CS09_2 cutscene frame): camera ~1.6 m high on the concrete boarding platform, looking across the hall at the docked black Funitel cabins hanging from the overhead guide rail with its rows of conveyor tyres; horizon y ~470; the cabins' floor and the platform edge with its handrail on y ~700-720 (~126 px per metre there). Perspective s(y) = (y - 470) / 545. Left: the open passage with daylight to the gondola arrival from Biela Put (exit), the red bullwheel; centre: a docked cabin with closed doors, the platform handrail, the boarding gate in front of a cabin with open doors (exit to the ride); right: Ivan by the gate, the two-section map board on a concrete pillar, the red steel frame of the station.
